name: California Olive Ranch Cold-Pressed Extra Virgin Olive Oil
whyItWorks: The gold-standard culinary fat in gastroenterology. Rich in monounsaturated oleic acid and oleocanthal (a natural phenolic compound that exerts anti-inflammatory effects mirroring ibuprofen without gastric toxicity). Soothes mucosal lining and aids nutrient absorption.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Drizzle 1–2 teaspoons over warm white rice, boiled carrots, or scrambled eggs. Safe across all disease phases.
watchOuts: Pure liquid fat; maintain standard 1-tablespoon servings.
